mentions.name: Cosmetic Surgery Recovery App
mentions.description: This iOS app helps users recover from cosmetic surgery by guiding them through surgeon instructions over days, weeks, and months, supporting physical and mental recovery as well as medical and dietary changes. It uses phone features including contacts, calendar events, and notifications, and is being built as an App Clip with the goal of partnering with surgeons to promote it in their offices.
mentions.problem: Recovery from cosmetic surgery involves juggling several balls for days, weeks, and months after the surgery.
